name: SkillBridge Career & Skill Taxonomy Dataset
description: Curated machine learning training and evaluation datasets for career recommendation, job matching, skill gap prediction, student clustering, and career readiness estimation.
sources: O*NET Online Occupational Classification (U.S. Department of Labor)
ESCO European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations
Open Tech Role Taxonomy & Curated Industry Job Profiles 2026

feature_engineering.career_recommendation: Multi-hot skill encoding + education level ordinal + domain preference one-hot + experience years scaling
feature_engineering.job_recommendation: TF-IDF vectorizer + Cosine Similarity & K-Nearest Neighbors (k=5)
feature_engineering.skill_clustering: K-Means (k=5) over normalized skill proficiency vectors
feature_engineering.readiness_prediction: Gradient Boosting / Random Forest Regressor over composite multi-modal indicators (technical skills, projects, ATS resume, mock interview, assessments)
